en: This sepia-toned postcard depicts a historic European street scene with early 20th-century architecture. Prominent buildings line both sides of the street, one marked as 'Gasthof zum Knopfkänzchen' and another labeled 'Hotel'. People in period clothing can be seen walking along the street, and a church steeple rises in the background. The upper right features the words 'Käublersstraße' and 'Bautzen' in old-style German script.
